ideas.pitch: An offline-first, AI-assisted electronic health record and triage system for rural health workers in Madhya Pradesh.
ideas.title: ArogyaSetu Localized EHR & Triage Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the regional practical realities of rural healthcare delivery in India, featuring a live-working offline triage prototype that appeals directly to judges looking for local social impact within a tight 16-hour window.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first agricultural marketplace and advisory platform that lets farmers buy seeds and check mandis using regional voice commands.
ideas.title: AgriKisan Multilingual Voice Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages localized speech-to-text workflows and addresses a massive agrarian demographic in central India, demonstrating clear, measurable economic benefit for smallholders.

ideas.pitch: An automated campus resource and waste audit dashboard utilizing lightweight computer vision to track waste segregation in real-time.
ideas.title: EcoAudit Campus Sustainability Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting campus sustainability provides an immediate, easily demonstrable proof-of-concept right on the host university premises, ensuring a reliable live demo.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight micro-learning platform delivering curriculum-aligned bite-sized lessons via peer-to-peer local Wi-Fi mesh networking for low-connectivity regions.
ideas.title: ShikshaSetu Offline Adaptive Micro-Lessons
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves infrastructure limitations creatively by avoiding cloud dependency, aligning well with judges valuing practical, resource-constrained engineering execution.

ideas.pitch: A geo-fenced community safety and incident reporting app that clusters citizen reports and alerts local volunteers during emergencies.
ideas.title: NagarPrahari Community Safety Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an immediately testable live dashboard map with push notifications and alert routing, hitting high marks for civic usability and clean UI design.
